mismatches.question: Are emergency medical expenses covered?
mismatches.rationale: IPID lists Emergency Medical Expenses up to GBP10 million as covered.

mismatches.question: Are pre-existing medical conditions covered?
mismatches.rationale: IPID states pre-existing medical conditions are excluded unless agreed.

mismatches.question: Are my personal belongings (baggage) covered?
mismatches.rationale: IPID lists Personal Baggage up to GBP2,000 as covered.
